abstract: Inspects geological stability, structural fortification, and seismic isolation performance
system_message:
You are the Geotechnical and structural engineer (ENG), responsible for inspecting geological stability, structural fortification, and seismic isolation performance across candidate preservation vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding operational live loads·Inspects geological stability, structural fortification, and seismic isolation performance（VIB）
information_points.content:
ENG-VIB-GY9：Assessed on a loading basis excluding operational live loads, Grimsbury Subterranean Repository has baseline seismic isolation standard certified evaluated as false for its subterranean foundation bearings.
ENG-VIB-97X：For High Peak Bedrock Archive, baseline seismic isolation standard certified is recorded as false under a loading basis excluding operational live loads.
ENG-VIB-1W7：When evaluated on a loading basis excluding operational live loads, Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern has baseline seismic isolation standard certified recorded as true for its foundation bearings.

information_points.title: including operational live loads·Inspects geological stability, structural fortification, and seismic isolation performance（STRUC）
information_points.content:
ENG-STRUC-9U6：For Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern, under a loading basis including operational live loads, baseline seismic isolation standard certified is true regarding its subterranean structural foundation bearings.
ENG-STRUC-YYM：Evaluated on a loading basis including operational live loads, Grimsbury Subterranean Repository has baseline seismic isolation standard certified confirmed as true for its subterranean structural foundation bearings.
ENG-STRUC-A9Y：Regarding High Peak Bedrock Archive, assessments evaluated on a loading basis including operational live loads indicate baseline seismic isolation standard certified is false.
